title: StationLayout
description: Per-station geometry, screen axis, marker grid, and amenities for coach-position displays

leftToward.description: Station names / codes toward screen left (typically UP / Secunderabad end)

rightToward.description: Station names / codes toward screen right (typically DOWN / Kazipet end)

spacingMeters.description: Distance between consecutive platform marker posts

secunderabadEnd.description: Which screen edge is the Secunderabad / UP end on the layout diagram

kazipetEnd.description: Which screen edge is the Kazipet / DOWN end on the layout diagram

islandWith.description: Other face id if island platform

engineStopNote.description: Ops note for where engine typically stops

secunderabadMarker.description: Marker number at the Secunderabad / UP end of this platform

kazipetMarker.description: Marker number at the Kazipet / DOWN end of this platform

id.description: Stable id within this station layout

platform.description: Platform id this amenity is on

markerFrom.description: Start marker along platform (inclusive); null if unknown

markerTo.description: End marker along platform (inclusive); null if unknown

displayId.description: Linked coach-position display profile id (category display)

linksTo.description: Amenity id on another platform (e.g. FOB landing on opposite PF)

linksToPlatforms.description: Platform ids reachable via this circulation amenity (e.g. FOB from PF1 to island PF2/PF3)

walkMetersFromDisplayPin.description: Walk distance from the linked display pin to this amenity (meters)

note.description: Ops note when marker position is TBD
